instruction: Open "/home/user/logo.png" in GIMP and convert it to a vector .eps file with editable paths.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot perform true raster-to-vector conversion to create editable vector paths in EPS format. While GIMP can save to EPS, it embeds the raster image rather than converting it to vector paths. True vectorization requires specialized software like Inkscape or Adobe Illustrator.
